# Indian Infotech
> Indian Infotech provides access control, biometric attendance, HRMS, payroll, visitor management, entrance management, and workplace operations systems across India.

## Guidance
Use the published product, software, industry, resource, and insight pages as the source of truth. Product compatibility, pricing, implementation timelines, integrations, and customer outcomes require confirmation through the contact route.
